2609.21423.title: DENSE: Distilling Agent Trajectories into Evidence-Grounded Shortcut Trees for Self-Refinement
2609.21423.paper_summary: Online agent deployments produce abundant execution traces, while task-specific verification and expert annotation are costly to scale. We study how to distill these traces into reusable feedback without post-hoc outcome labels, drawing on their evidence of local progress, recovery, and unfinished requirements. We introduce DENSE (Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions), which organizes this evidence into evidence-grounded nested shortcut trees. DENSE compresses redundant attempts, reconciles issues across levels using recovery evidence, and summarizes completed branches while expanding unresolved ones, linking reusable progress to remaining obligations. We introduce REFIT, a source-paired protocol comparing feedback from shared initial trajectories under post-hoc outcome blindness, with environments and model contexts reset for fresh attempts at the same tasks. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, DENSE achieves the highest strict pass rate among tested non-privileged feedback methods across four recipient models. Relative to initial executions, strict pass rate improves by 7.12-15.64 pp, with 19.0-43.6% fewer observed recipient tokens in reruns. GPT-5.5 ablations support combining nested subtask analysis with shortcut construction and issue reconciliation. These findings point toward agent self-refinement through evidence-grounded trajectory reuse with less reliance on external supervision.
2609.21423.paper_summary_zh: 線上代理部署產生了大量的執行痕跡，但針對特定任務的驗證和專家註釋在擴展上成本高昂。<lb/>我們研究如何在沒有事後結果標籤的情況下，將這些痕跡提煉成可重用的反饋，利用它們在局部進展、恢復和未完成需求方面的證據。<lb/>我們引入了 DENSE（從嵌套子任務執行中提煉證據），它將這些證據組織成基於證據的嵌套捷徑樹。<lb/>DENSE 壓縮冗餘的嘗試，利用恢復證據調和不同層級之間的問題，並在擴展未解決的分支的同時總結已完成的分支，將可重用的進展與剩餘的義務聯繫起來。<lb/>我們引入了 REFIT，一種源配對協議，通過事後結果盲目性比較來自共享初始軌跡的反饋，並在相同任務的新嘗試中重置環境和模型上下文。<lb/>在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，DENSE 在四個接收模型中測試的非特權反饋方法中達到了最高的嚴格通過率。<lb/>相對於初始執行，嚴格通過率提高了 7.12-15.64 個百分點，重跑中觀察到的接收代幣數量減少了 19.0-43.6%。<lb/>GPT-5.5 的消融實驗支持將嵌套子任務分析與捷徑構建和問題調和相結合。<lb/>這些發現指向通過基於證據的軌跡重用實現代理自我精煉，並減少對外部監督的依賴。
